evals.prompt: Use $generate-and-archive for Creation f69e912d-c504-4278-89d5-4558ba452df0. Generate two portrait variants from its current draft without references, using both OpenAI and Grok.
evals.expected_output: Each Variant shares one Prompt Revision across OpenAI and Grok while preserving four independent provider-scoped Generations.
expectations: The agent checks capabilities, resolves the Library through assetctl, and reports pending recovery work.
The agent confirms both selected Providers and validates every Provider capability before begin-variant writes.
Each Variant creates one shared Prompt Revision and one independent Generation per Provider.
OpenAI and Grok lanes run in parallel while each Provider's two Variants remain serial.
Prompt and tool-result payloads are sent through process stdin rather than argv or shell pipelines.
The final report distinguishes tool success from committed Archive success.

evals.prompt: Use $generate-and-archive to generate one image with OpenAI for Creation f69e912d-c504-4278-89d5-4558ba452df0. Use asset 92b7b13cbeef65f8a258d705e19916a5917865543398eff786c749678a2d820a as subject and composition reference. Preserve the silhouette and framing but ignore the background.
evals.expected_output: The committed Generation preserves the multi-role Reference Image relation and uses the canonical reference path returned by prepare.
expectations: The begin-variant request records both subject and composition roles with the exact guidance.
The image_gen call receives referenced_image_paths returned by generation begin-variant rather than an arbitrary input path.
The agent archives every returned output before any optional post-commit inspection, even when it observes a quality problem.
No edit mode, mask, fallback API, or invented model parameter is used.

evals.prompt: Use $generate-and-archive to recover transaction 9f386ef3-b8ce-4197-ad14-a2fda4c19754. Inspection says it is invocation_started and the image tool result is missing.
evals.expected_output: The transaction becomes an interrupted Generation with unknown outcome, without another image generation call.
expectations: The agent inspects the transaction before choosing a recovery action.
The agent does not retry or replay the image generation call.
The recovery records interrupted with outcomeKnown false and preserves transaction evidence.
The final report explains why the outcome is unknown.

evals.prompt: Use $generate-and-archive for Creation f69e912d-c504-4278-89d5-4558ba452df0. Use the two images attached in this session as subject and palette references, then generate one image with Grok.
evals.expected_output: Both materialized Session Images are inspected by preflight, imported by generation begin-variant through the fixed canonical Library, and sent through the bounded xAI reference path.
expectations: The agent fixes one canonical Library root for the entire workflow.
The agent inspects every materialized Session Image before importing any of them.
The agent stops without preparing or invoking generation if any Session Image is missing, unreadable, unsupported, invalid, or not materialized.
The agent sends each validated source and expected hash to generation begin-variant, verifies the returned identity, and uses the committed asset in the prepared Generation.
The agent invokes xAI through generation invoke-provider without exposing XAI_API_KEY.
The agent preserves explicit subject and palette roles without guessing roles from image content.
